awards.name: Digital Technology Leaders Award
awards.note: Diversity Initiative of the Year, with HSBC

bullets.t: Led product and six engineers, and wrote 28% of the build's commits. The AI tutor went from first commit to the App Store in under a month and reached 10,000 students, with 47% of monthly users back every week.
Marking accuracy from a 67% bare-model baseline to over 99% against official mark schemes. The DfE picked the tutor for its AI Tutoring Tools Pioneers Programme, with a £300k grant.
The school hub reached 850+ UK schools. 91% of students activate when a teacher rolls it out, against 23% on their own.

Designated safeguarding lead. Built message flagging from regex to AI flags, image recognition and hash matching: about 20 cases a month, none missed, false alarms down 86%, schools answered in 2.3 hours on average.
Employee #4. ISO 27001 and 9001 done solo as DPO, which unlocked our first FTSE 100 contracts, and the revenue ops behind £1.5m ARR.
An AI assistant resolved 91% of conversations, so a dedicated support hire was no longer needed. CSAT 84%, NPS 80+.
Mentee-to-mentor conversion from 6% to 40%, keeping 120,000 students on one platform from school to university.

roles.photoAlt: The Zero Gravity team in the office, gathered round a sofa under the company sign

paras: Elliot is the ultimate startup operator — a genuine Swiss Army knife who has made an impact across customer success, operations and product at Zero Gravity.

He doesn't just understand what AI makes possible; he builds with it, experiments rapidly and ships. He now contributes as many PRs as some of our senior engineers, while bringing the customer insight and commercial judgement you would expect from a strong product leader.
If I were starting another business tomorrow, Elliot would be one of the first people I'd try to hire.

bullets.t: Led the probate service between customers, legal specialists and the case team, inside SRA and FCA regulation.
Case-agent errors down 69% and case handling from two weeks to four days, through HMCTS, HMRC and bank integrations.
Fixed the input errors eating 30% of solicitor time, so two solicitors did the work of five.
NPS from 20 to 80+, and the vulnerable-customer framework the whole company adopted.
Day 1 was a WhatsApp group; day 10 was a four-sided marketplace in production.
303,000 meals in 100 days to 146 hospitals from 223 restaurants, 97% on time.
£1.8m raised, and a volunteer team grown from 6 to 120 with a hiring playbook other leads could run.
Built CX and crisis operations from nothing: no CRM, ticketing or supplier contracts.
NPS held above 90 through 400% year-on-year growth.
The US launch hit its 12-week plan on the day, and the international partner network tripled.
Hired and trained the first 15 ops staff, with a 100% safety record through the Sri Lanka attacks and COVID closures.
